2.EN:
Do you know where the pendant is?
Could you help me find it?

3.EN: She's talking to a black cat in a very serious tone.

4.EN: Without that pendant, I can't forge a pact to make that person my familiar.

5.EN:
You must know who I'm talking about, don't you?
The second I laid my eyes on him, the wheels of fate started turning.

8.EN:
The black cat purrs as if in reply,
and walks off with its tail lifted high.

9.EN: Hehe... That's right... Fate herself will surely guide Favna...

10.EN: Fafna follows the cat and leaves.

12.EN: (I was going to talk to her, but I missed my chance.)

14.EN: (...Either way, I should head back for today.)

15.EN: (I thought I'd be able to find her here...)

16.EN:
(But now that I actually want to talk to her,
she's nowhere to be seen. What an elusive girl.)

17.EN: (Guess I'll just have to wait for the day I'll run into her again...)

19.EN: (I thought we were meeting at the park... It's not like Shiro to be late.)

23.EN: Ohhh, I'm so sorry! I got nervous last night and couldn't sleep for some reason...

24.EN: "Don't worry, I just got here too."

25.EN:
I hope I haven't forgotten anything...
Oh! Um, I hope my hair doesn't look weird!

27.EN:
Ohh, thank goodness!
That's one less thing to worry about.

28.EN: Wh... H-Heyyy, don't tease me like that!

29.EN:
"Anyway, where should we go?
Last time I went with Miyu, we went to the Shopping Association, so..."

30.EN:
Um, could we go to the Shopping Association again?
Only if you don't mind, of course!

31.EN:
There's a lot of great shops we haven't been to yet,
so I wanted to show you around!

32.EN:
"That sounds like a good idea.
I've been itching to learn more about this city."

33.EN: I'm glad to hear that! Then let's go!

35.EN: "I'm so sorry! I hope you didn't miss me too much..."

36.EN:
A-Absolutely not! I have always been a solitary existence.
Such trivial matters are hardly enough to aggravate me!

37.EN:
"I see... But still, let me make it up to you.
I'll go wherever you want today."

38.EN:
A charitable offer. I was planning on inviting you
to the Lustrous Mansion of Glamourous Garments.

39.EN:
"Garments...? Oh, do you mean like a boutique?
Sure, we can stop by later."

41.EN: Then let us depart, my familiar. Come!

42.EN:
Ooh, a magic circle!
Just like the ones in Magic Angel!

43.EN:
You had us grab some chicken, tomato juice, and red food coloring...
I reckoned you were gonna cook us somethin'.

44.EN:
Drawing a magic circle with materials that are in line
with the caster's attributes enhances its effects, you see.

45.EN:
In my case, I cannot use real blood...
So I will use red ingredients to imitate its appearance.

46.EN:
The circle is complete.
...Stand there, my familiar.

48.EN:
My will creates your body, and your grail creates my destiny.
If you heed the Holy Key and obey my will and reason, then answer me!

49.EN:
I have summoned the power of heroic spirits of yore to unlock your true potential.
Undoubtedly, you have become even more formidable!

50.EN: (Favna worked really hard on this, so I'll just play along.)

51.EN:
Great work, everyone. Let's all get some rest for now
and go meet the ghost tomorrow!

52.EN:
It might be because of the ritual Favna performed on you,
but you slept very soundly that night.

53.EN:
Hoo, that was fun! Now that I think about it,
I ended up draggin' ya all over the place. Was that okay with ya?

55.EN: Ehehe... I'm happy ya came along too. Thanks!

56.EN: ...No, but really. I got a lot to thank ya for, Manager.

58.EN:
Oh, y'know, at home I'm always the big sister, so...
I always end up bein' the one draggin' everyone else along.

59.EN:
And Daddy ain't the most meticulous man, even though he's a priest,
so I'm the main person in charge of the family's finances.

60.EN:
So the ladies in the neighborhood always say stuff like,
"You're so mature, Honoka-chan!"

61.EN:
When Nanoka and Nonoka were born I was happy to hear
that I'd just become an older sister.

62.EN: ...But one time, when I heard someone call me mature again...

63.EN:
I started to think, what if they're actually
sayin' I'm stingy, or unladylike... or somethin'.

64.EN: After that, I stopped likin' when people called me mature.

65.EN:
And I never really liked the part of me
that always frets over the tiniest details...

66.EN:
But y'know how Shiro complimented me
when we were brainstormin' for the stamp rally?

67.EN:
She showered me with compliments so sincerely,
it didn't feel bad at all.

68.EN:
So did Miyu and Favnyan... and ya did too.
And y'all stuck with me even when I started takin' the lead for no reason.

69.EN:
So I was... happy. I didn't expect anyone
to think I was all reliable and... worth somethin'.

70.EN:
So I, um... I'm real grateful that ya introduced me to Fuwa Fuwa,
so that I could meet y'all and have ya in my life. That's all.

71.EN: "I think you're a remarkable person, Honoka."

73.EN:
"You take care of your family
and support everyone in Fuwa Fuwa at the same time."

74.EN:
I mean, sure, at least for the family part...
but you're the one who supports us, not the other way round.

75.EN: I just got a li'l yappy this time 'cause I'm kinda good with money, that's all.

76.EN:
You're the one supportin' the maids of Fuwa Fuwa... includin' me.
We're all countin' on ya, y'know?

77.EN:
But for real, Manager... Ya must've been a real
impressive guy before you came to Fuwa Fuwa.

79.EN:
...Oh, would ya look at the time. I should go home
and make dinner. If I don't go soon, the li'l ones—
and the big ones too—are gonna starve to death.

80.EN:
Time sure flies when you're havin' fun.
How was your day, Manager?

81.EN: I had a lot of fun!:option3;The day's not over yet...:option4

82.EN:
Really? Good! I'm sorry for draggin' ya along,
but I was really happy to have ya with me!

83.EN:
Ahaha! Right, right! But we've been walkin' so much my legs
feel like jelly, so we should be good and go home for the day.

84.EN:
Besides, ya gotta get prepared for the talk
with the chairman tomorrow, right?

85.EN: Don't stay up too late and make sure to get enough rest, okay?

87.EN:
Well then, thanks for hangin' out with me today.
Let's go watch another movie together someday!
See ya tomorrow!

88.EN: Hm? There's something buried in the sand...

89.EN: Whoa! You found a Silver Sound Card!
